[EN] Day in and day out, people read and peruse. But not one person puts their book back where they got it!

Is it too much to ask? Have these people no manners?
[ES] Día tras día, la gente lee y hojea. ¡Pero ni una sola persona devuelve su libro al lugar donde lo encontró!

¿Es mucho pedir? ¿Esta gente no tiene modales?
